title: Level 1 gameplay lifecycle
summary: Recover the Level 1 gameplay lifecycle slice for pause/resume, damage, death, and respawn with gameplay-checkpoint parity against the oracle capture.

capabilities.title: Recover pause and resume parity
capabilities.summary: Compare the native pause/resume lifecycle checkpoints directly against the gameplay oracle capture.
done_criteria: The pause/resume gameplay checkpoints match the oracle capture.
Pausing freezes gameplay state and resuming advances it again without breaking the native lifecycle flow.

capabilities.title: Close the Level 1 damage-trigger research gap
capabilities.summary: Document the gameplay hazard and transition path that produces the first life-cycle shift in Level 1.
done_criteria: The gameplay lifecycle dossier no longer lists the Level 1 damage-trigger task as open.
The native gameplay lifecycle uses an explicit damage/death transition instead of the old opening-slice stand-in.

capabilities.title: Recover death and respawn parity
capabilities.summary: Match the Level 1 death/respawn lifecycle checkpoints against the gameplay oracle capture.
done_criteria: The death/respawn gameplay checkpoints match the oracle capture.
The native runtime loses one life, hides the player during the death window, and restores the Level 1 respawn state by the respawn-tail checkpoint.

capabilities.title: Close the gameplay lifecycle loop
capabilities.summary: Leave the gameplay lifecycle slice with a complete autonomy contract and no remaining open lifecycle tasks.
done_criteria: The autonomy loop reports the gameplay lifecycle goal as complete.
The repo docs point at the gameplay lifecycle goal and comparison command as the next source-port slice after the opening slice.
